name: hello-ios-example
description: Pure-native UIKit hello: tish:ios host only (no tish-desktop). Cross-device broker/webview demo lives in tish-desktop/examples/hello-ios.

scripts.build: cargo run --manifest-path ../../../tish/Cargo.toml -q -p tishlang -- build --target native --native-backend rust --crate-type staticlib --ios-triple aarch64-apple-ios-sim --platform ios --surface native src/main.tish -o dist/hello-ios
scripts.build:device: cargo run --manifest-path ../../../tish/Cargo.toml -q -p tishlang -- build --target native --native-backend rust --crate-type staticlib --ios-triple aarch64-apple-ios --platform ios --surface native src/main.tish -o dist/hello-ios
